title: US-Canada trade talks collapse, testing Ottawa's strategy of firmness
subhead: As negotiations broke down on Friday, the US is putting new 50% tariffs on a range of Canadian products, starting Saturday. Ottawa has vowed to respond with tariffs of equal scope.

title: In southern Lebanon, a 'race between preserving memory and Israel's destruction'
subhead: Lebanese people, both individually and through non-profit organizations, have sought to collect footage and testimonies in order to preserve the memory of the region, which is partially occupied by Israel, and to showcase its historical richness.

title: Mont Blanc massif destablilized by summer heatwaves and rockfalls

title: Kyiv's brief glimmers of joy amidst war: 'Never in my life have I seen so many beautiful people in one place'

Soldiers on leave and families joined partygoers to dance and celebrate Ukrainian folklore inside this rare bubble of peace.
